requires.label: Patient must be uninsured or underinsured
requires.quote: Patients who are uninsured or underinsured are ineligible for any government health care benefit program and unable to pay for their health care services may be eligible for financial assistance.

rules.label: Internal Charity Care
rules.quote: Eligibility shall be based solely on the total gross family income adjusted for family size and is only applicable to outpatient services. Assets shall not be considered and will be based on Middle Park Health's internal sliding scale.

notes: HDC rates are set by the Colorado Department of Health Care Policy & Financing; discount_pct is null because the amount is a state rate table.
Internal Charity uses an internal sliding scale not expressed in FPL bands; discount_pct is null.
AccessOne and Internal Payment Plans are payment options, not discounts; discount_pct is null.
Policy requires cooperation, truthful application, and timely documentation; these are procedural and not modeled as eligibility requirements.
Charity application denied if financial information not provided within 45 days; 30-day appeal window after denial.
Charity approval covers accounts within 6 months of signed application date; leadership discretion beyond 6 months.
Patients may be required to apply for Medicaid prior to charity assistance; Medicaid eligibility reverses charity adjustments.
Hospital prohibits actions discouraging emergency care; complies with EMTALA.
Decisions never consider age, gender, race, color, national origin, marital status, social or immigrant status, sexual orientation, or religious affiliation.
Exclusions of services (cosmetic, transplant, research) not addressed in policy text.
Provider payment plans under HDC limited to 2% of gross monthly household income per provider, max 36 months.

findings.title: Covers everyone Colorado's Hospital Discounted Care protects

law.source: HCPF Hospital Discounted Care Operations Manual, Mar 31 2026
law.quote: Patients and their households are eligible for Hospital Discounted Care if, during the required screening and application processes, they are determined to: Have a total household income at or below 250% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines (FPG), and Be residents of the State of Colorado.
IF REQUESTED BY THE PATIENT, A HEALTH-CARE FACILITY SHALL SCREEN AN INSURED PATIENT FOR DISCOUNTED CARE

findings.summary: A household of 3 earning $27,000 a year (98.8% of the poverty line), living in Colorado, insured, and not under-insured as the policy defines it is turned away by this requirement: "Patient must be uninsured or underinsured". Colorado law makes them eligible for Hospital Discounted Care.
